lesson_title: The Four-Letter Recipe Behind Every Advert
hook_text: Every advert that works follows the same four-letter recipe. Once you see it, you can't unsee it.
clip_script: A: Attention. A giant steaming vetkoek and one word: COLD? You stop. I: Interest. Fresh, hot vetkoek with mince, Gogo's secret recipe. Now you know what it is and why you'd want it. D: Desire. Sold out in 20 minutes last year! Two for R15, Friday only. Now you want it. A: Action. School gate, first and second break, Friday. Bring cash. Now you know what to do. Pretty poster with no place or price? Missing the last A. Wall of tiny text? Missing the first. Notice, understand, want, do. That is AIDA.
visual_style: A whiteboard poster building in four layers, each labelled A, I, D, A, followed by two weak posters with a missing letter circled.
mood: Punchy and clever, a design reveal.
pacing: Four fast layers, a quick fix-it round, then a one-line recap.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and check your favourite advert for all four letters.
